name: Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Annual Report - Itemized List of Expenditures from the Special Tax Allocation Fund

columns.name: TIF Number
columns.description: The unique, numeric ID assigned to the TIF district.

columns.name: TIF District
columns.description: Redevelopment project area

columns.name: Report Year
columns.description: Calendar year to which the record applies

columns.name: Cost of Studies
columns.description: Implementation and administration of the redevelopment plan, staff, and professional service cost

columns.name: Administrative Cost
columns.description: Costs associated with general administration of the business.

columns.name: Marketing Sites
columns.description: Amount of money spent on marketing.

columns.name: Site Preparation Costs
columns.description: Costs for land clearing to prepare the building site.

columns.name: Renovation, Rehab, Etc.
columns.description: Costs of renovation, rehabilitation, reconstruction, and repair of existing public or private buildings within a redevelopment project area.

columns.name: Public Works
columns.description: Costs of construction of public works or improvements.

columns.name: Removing Contaminants
columns.description: Costs of eliminating or removing contaminants and other impediments.

columns.name: Job Training
columns.description: Costs of job training and retraining projects.

columns.name: Financing Costs
columns.description: Cost, interest, and other charges involved in the borrowing of money to build or purchase assets.

columns.name: Capital Costs
columns.description: Fixed, one-time expenses incurred on the purchase of land, buildings, construction, and equipment used in the rendering of services.

columns.name: School Districts
columns.description: Costs of reimbursing school districts for their increased costs caused by TIF assisted housing projects.

columns.name: Library Districts
columns.description: Costs of reimbursing library districts for their increased costs caused by TIF assisted housing projects.

columns.name: Relocation Costs
columns.description: Costs incurred during the course of moving to a new residence.

columns.name: In Lieu of Taxes
columns.description: A payment made to compensate a government for some or all the property tax revenue lost due to tax exempt ownership or use of a real property.

columns.name: Job Training/Retraining
columns.description: Costs of job training, retraining, advanced-vocational, or career education.

columns.name: Interest Cost
columns.description: Costs of interest incurred by developer related to the construction, renovation, or rehabilitation of a redevelopment project.

columns.name: New Housing
columns.description: Costs of construction of new housing units for low-income or very-low-income households.

columns.name: Day Care Services
columns.description: Costs associated with day care services for children of employees from low -income families working for businesses located within TIF area.

columns.name: Other
columns.description: Any other form of expense not clearly categorized.
